item.title: Wednesday 10 AM Update, Oct 28
item.description:
The Wednesday ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 28, 2026: conditions around Londonderry through tomorrow morning; a grand jury declines to indict Cassidy Hutchinson, a judge rules Los Angeles's top federal prosecutor is serving unlawfully, and Trump eases some Canada tariffs; the Spain train crash toll rises sharply, Israel's soldiers' ballots, and Serbia's state broadcaster apologizes; markets at the open with Vertiv, Boston Scientific and Wendy's on the move and Canada's first rate hike in three years; Amazon's new Echo lineup and Apple's event this afternoon; New York's new limits on A.I. chatbots for kids; attackers probing a fresh Oracle flaw and a device-code phishing campaign; your X feed; a Salem manhunt and tonight's debates; and a Cape Cod volunteer driver. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

The Tuesday ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 27, 2026: conditions around Londonderry through tomorrow morning; the Justice Department's third attempt to charge James Comey, today's California ballot hearing, and a manhunt for an escaped Tennessee inmate; record turnout in Israel's election, the Oleshky truce extended to Sunday, and Iran's ask for a two-week pause; markets as Boeing posts a loss, Coca-Cola beats and consumer confidence lands; Apple's M6 MacBook Pro and iMac, iPhone Duo screen complaints and Intel's quantum buy; OpenAI's cheaper GPT-6.1 Terra, an Anthropic claim on a famous math conjecture, and a $63 billion chip financing deal; urgent iPhone updates for older models, a patched Microsoft Authenticator flaw and Tailscale's pending fix; your X feed; federal election monitors in Manchester and Nashua and trick-or-treat times; and an 86-year-old Texan's dream boat.
